notes: Investigated thoroughly (site is a NetSuite SuiteCommerce Advanced storefront, client-rendered; robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow, generic Disallow: /? only). Checked: (1) fully rendered mega-menu + footer nav via Playwright (296 unique links captured) - no Christmas, Halloween, Easter, Diwali, Valentine's, Thanksgiving, New Year, or any other holiday/seasonal category node present; the only seasonal-worded item is 'Seasonal Clearance' under Sale > Clearance, a generic markdown page mixing leftover Christmas (9), Easter (9) and other-category items with no single-holiday identity - excluded as a Sale/Clearance page per core rules and Seasonal rules Sec.4. (2) Category sitemap (SitemapFiles/PKUK/sitemap-*-PKUK-category-0.xml) lists a Christmas taxonomy (christmas-featured-shops, christmas-shop-category incl. advent-calendars/all-christmas/ornaments-decor/pyjamas/stocking-stuffers/stockings/tabletop/xmas-bed-linen, collaborations-christmas, in-stock-christmas) but every one of these URLs, plus the bare /christmas root, now 301-redirects to /sale/shop-clearance/seasonal-clearance - confirmed dead/retired for the season via HTTP HEAD checks, not just hidden from nav. No other holiday appears anywhere in this sitemap. (3) CMS and customurl sitemaps (sitemap-*-PKUK-cms-0.xml, sitemap-*-PKUK-customurl-0.xml) grepped for christmas/halloween/easter/valentine/diwali/festive/holiday/thanksgiving/new-year/xmas/advent - zero matches. (4) Ran the required discrimination check on internal site search before accepting absence: queries for halloween/valentine/diwali/easter/thanksgiving/'new year' all returned an identical flat '1038 products' - a known non-discriminating default result (per project trap notes), so search was correctly not used as evidence either way; absence is based on nav/sitemap inspection alone. Conclusion: Pottery Barn Kids UK currently has no live, genuine seasonal/holiday product-listing category - unlike PB Kids US (SR5), which was independently verified to have a real Halloween/Christmas/Hanukkah/Thanksgiving/Valentine's/Easter taxonomy; the UK site does not mirror it and is presently thinner still (its formerly-live Christmas branch has been taken down/redirected off-season). No rows to report.
